title: Add “High Capacity 26 Passenger Lifts” image to Property Gallery

requirements.summary: Add the uploaded elevator photo as a new static frontend asset and reference it in the Property Gallery.
acceptanceCriteria: A new image file exists under frontend/public/assets/generated with the exact filename specified in the image requirements.
The app loads the new image via a /assets/generated/... path without any backend changes.
The image renders correctly in the browser (no broken image link).

file_operations.description: Add the provided uploaded image asset with the exact required filename so it can be served as a static file.
Reference the new static asset from the gallery image list using the /assets/generated/high-capacity-26-passenger-lifts.dim_1536x1024.png path (no backend changes).

requirements.summary: Insert a new Property Gallery card after “Terrace / Rooftop” labeled “High Capacity 26 Passenger Lifts” with appropriate alt text.
acceptanceCriteria: In the gallery UI, the new item appears directly after the “Terrace / Rooftop” item.
The card’s displayed heading/label is exactly “High Capacity 26 Passenger Lifts”.
The new gallery item includes appropriate alt text describing the image content (in English).

file_operations.description: Update the images array to insert a new item immediately after the existing “Terrace / Rooftop” entry, with label exactly “High Capacity 26 Passenger Lifts” and an English alt text describing the photo (e.g., two elevator doors in a modern lobby), keeping layout/styling unchanged.
